items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Maestri had a furniture store. And then people would go buy a set of furniture, and they couldn't pay for it.

ctx.x: Did you know that song about Maestri's wagons been here until?

Yeah, right, you see, them times, them people used to buy furniture on time, you see, for Maestri. Maestri had a furniture store. And then people would go buy a set of furniture, and they couldn't pay for it. And they, they'd make up a contract with the Maestri, furniture store, but they ain't gonna pay so much a month. But when the time was due, it would fail to show up and pay for it. 된 stuff with

Well, he had wagons. He said, Mace was wagging that vinyan and took all my furniture and gone. Wagon, back the wagon on. Go to Central Place, tell the driver. He did all that furniture out there. Men, two men come knock on the door. I want to get this furniture. And they have police with them. How much you going to do to police?
